atAGlance: Mực hấp gừng is squid steamed with ginger, usually with scallion, herbs, and ginger fish sauce.
whatItIs: Mực hấp gừng is squid steamed with ginger, scallions, and light aromatics. It should smell fresh and stay tender rather than rubbery.
howToEnjoy: Eat soon after steaming, dipping lightly in ginger fish sauce or lime-pepper salt if served. Overcooked squid gets tough, so timing matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order mực hấp gừng when you want a lighter squid dish. Ask for less chili and check freshness by the ginger-steam aroma when it arrives.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese seafood shops, steamed squid is chosen for freshness: ginger lifts the aroma without hiding the seafood.
goodToKnow: Fresh squid should smell clean and gingery, not fishy.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
